seo.title: Contact — Apex Home Services
seo.description: Get a quote from Apex Home Services. Lenexa, KS — serving the Kansas City metro. Licensed, bonded, insured. Same business day reply.

header.heading:
Tell us what you need.
We'll phone-quote or book an estimate.
header.lead: Send a short request and the office will read it, phone-quote what we can from photos, and book a free in-home estimate for anything bigger. Same business day reply during weekday hours. Photos help us price faster — drag them into the form or text them to (913) 555-0177.

form.successMessage: Got it — your request is in. The office will read it and reply the same business day with a phone-quote or a window for a free in-home estimate.
form.errorMessage: Something went wrong. Please try again or call us directly at (913) 555-0177.

infoCards.title: Phone or text
infoCards.body: Same number for calls and texts. Photos welcome — they help us phone-quote.

infoCards.title: Response Time
infoCards.body: Same business day reply during Mon–Sat 7a–6p. Most handyman work books 1–2 weeks out; remodels 4–8 weeks.

infoCards.title: Real emergency?
infoCards.body: If it's a fire, gas leak, active flooding, or a downed live wire, please call 911 first. Once you're safe, call us at (913) 555-0177 and we'll coordinate the repair.

expect.heading: What to expect
items: A real reply from the office, not an auto-responder
Phone-quote for small jobs we can price from your description and photos
Free in-home estimate scheduled for remodels and bigger electrical work
If we're not the right crew, an honest referral to a partner
